text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the overnight outage—vendor auth throttling in us-west caused model-registry reads to back up and a 5xx spike for hosted inference. Starting action-tracking thread.

sam: timeline and customer impact?

elaine: ~3% 5xx for ~35m, four Dedicated tenants saw latency blips. No data loss. Chain: vendor returned 429s on token introspect -> registry retries -> downstream 500s.

priya: vendor admits a policy rollout mis-keyed limits. They're producing an RCA. We need short/mid/long term mitigations.

jon: this fits the recurring "token-throttle" pattern. Recommend treating as incident class and tracking trend.

marta: logged customer notes and opened vendor ticket VND-1201.

elaine: Proposed actions:
- Hotfix (P0): increase local token cache TTL from 30s -> 5m + add randomized backoff. Owner: priya. Due: 2999080000.
- Near (P1): circuit-breaker for token introspects + feature-flagged fallback provider. Owner: sam. Due: 2999900000.
- Vendor (P0): request SLA credit, dedicated key, written postmortem. Owner: marta. Due: 2999030000.
- Runbook (P1): add detection rule for auth 429 bursts and automated mitigation steps. Owner: jon. Due: 2999050000.

priya: taking hotfix. I'll open PR for TTL bump + jittered backoff and emit cache-hit metric. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: I'll scope circuit-breaker and evaluate fallback options (local minting vs vendor backup key) with devsec. ETA: 2 weeks.

marta: vendor ticket updated; requesting corrective quota and postmortem. Drafting customer comms template.

ops-bot: Actions recorded INC-2150: https://tracker.internal/INC-2150 (items: TOKEN-501, CB-502, VND-1201, RUN-503).

jon: I'll add the detection rule and a staging canary that simulates token throttling. ETA: 4 days.

elaine: Scheduling a weekly resilience sync for 4 weeks then monthly—@sam to send invites. We'll review progress Friday EOD. Treat recurrence as a trend on the resilience board.

priya: ack, starting work.

sam: ack.

jon: ack, drafting runbook edits.

marta: ack, monitoring vendor response.

elaine: Thanks all. Reopen thread if blockers surface.
